corpus.text: In this tutorial we configure vector database indexing using ChromaDB and sentence transformers for dense semantic retrieval.
SQLite FTS5 full text search provides exact BM25 keyword matching for technical terms, names, and acronyms.
Reciprocal rank fusion merges dense vector similarity scores and lexical rank positions with a constant k of 60.
Cross-encoder models score query and candidate document pairs jointly using full cross-attention layers.
FFmpeg audio extraction normalizes sound tracks into 16kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV for optimal speech recognition.
PySceneDetect performs content-aware visual scene cut detection by comparing frame color histogram deltas.
The Model Context Protocol MCP allows Claude Desktop and Cursor to query local tools and database indexes.
HTTP 206 partial content streaming supports HTML5 video range requests jumping to exact timestamps without downloading whole files.
Evaluating information retrieval systems requires MRR at 10, NDCG at 10, and Recall at K metrics.
Faster-Whisper runs CTranslate2 quantized int8 and fp16 automatic speech recognition on local CPU or GPU.
